title: rosa canina f. spuria
intro: Rosa canina f. spuria, commonly known as the wild rose or dog rose, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is a deciduous shrub known for its fragrant flowers and edible fruits, which provide numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. spuria include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce menstrual cramps, and support skin health due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and vitamin C. The bioactive constituents present in Rosa canina f. spuria, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and vitamin C, contribute to its medicinal properties.
